title: Italian sidelines
intro: 3...h6, 3...d6, 3...Nd4, 3...f5 and 3...Be7: rarer replies, and a trap to avoid.
variation: e2e4 e7e5 g1f3 b8c6 f1c4 h7h6, e2e4 e7e5 g1f3 b8c6 f1c4 d7d6, e2e4 e7e5 g1f3 b8c6 f1c4 c6d4, e2e4 e7e5 g1f3 b8c6 f1c4 f7f5, e2e4 e7e5 g1f3 b8c6 f1c4 f8e7

lessons.title: 3...h6: hit the centre
lessons.summary: A slow move lets you open the centre with d4.

steps.text: 3...h6 stops Ng5, but it brings out no piece.
Black is a move behind. Hit the centre now.
steps.ifWrong: 4.d4 strikes at once while Black is slow.

steps.text: Black takes with 4...exd4.
Take back with the piece that sits best in the centre.
steps.ifWrong: 5.Nxd4: the knight is strong in the centre.
steps.ifRight: If Black trades knights, your queen takes back and rules the board.

steps.text: 5...Nxd4 trades knights.
Take back.
steps.ifWrong: 6.Qxd4: the queen is strong on d4 and hard to chase away.
steps.ifRight: You are ahead in development and stand clearly better.

steps.text: Black tries another quiet move, 3...Be7. Find the same answer.
steps.ifWrong: 4.d4: 3...Be7 is passive, so hit the centre.
steps.ifRight: After ...exd4, take back and enjoy the better centre.

lessons.title: 3...d6: calm, then Ng5
lessons.summary: Develop with d3; if ...Nf6 comes, f7 is weak.

steps.text: 3...d6 is solid, but it shuts in Black's bishop on f8.
Develop calmly. Keep e4 protected.
steps.ifRight: If Black plays ...Nf6, look at the f7 square.

feedback.d2d4: 4.d4 is good too. This repertoire stays calm with 4.d3.

steps.text: 4...Nf6 develops, but f7 now has only the king to guard it.
Attack f7 twice.
steps.hint: Your knight can jump towards f7.
steps.ifWrong: 5.Ng5 hits f7 with the knight and the bishop.
steps.ifRight: Two attackers on f7, and Black must find a defence.

steps.text: 5...d5 blocks the bishop's line to f7.
From the Two Knights: 3...Nf6 4.d3 d6. Find the attacking move.
steps.ifWrong: 5.Ng5 attacks f7 with the knight and the bishop.

lessons.title: 3...Nd4: do not take the pawn
lessons.summary: The e5 pawn is bait. Take the knight instead.

steps.text: 3...Nd4 leaves the e5 pawn hanging. It is a trap.
Many players grab it with 4.Nxe5. Watch what happens.
4...Qg5 attacks the knight on e5 and the pawn on g2 at once.
5.Nxf7 attacks the rook on h8, but it ignores the real threat.
5...Qxg2 attacks your rook on h1.
6.Rf1 saves the rook.
6...Qxe4+ checks, and the knight on d4 joins in.
7.Be2 blocks the check.
7...Nf3 is checkmate.
Back to 3...Nd4. Do not take on e5. Find the safe capture.
steps.hint: Take the knight that came forward.
steps.ifRight: Black must take back with a pawn.

feedback.f3e5: 4.Nxe5 walks into 4...Qg5, which attacks the knight and g2 at once. Black comes out on top.

steps.text: 4...exd4. Black has lost time, and the pawn on d4 can become a target.
Develop simply.
steps.ifWrong: 5.d3, then castle and play c3 against the d4 pawn.
steps.ifRight: Castling and c3 come next, opening lines against d4.

steps.text: Black plays 3...Nd4. The e5 pawn looks free. Find the best move.
steps.hint: Take a piece, not the pawn.
steps.ifWrong: 4.Nxd4: the pawn on e5 is bait.
steps.ifRight: You avoid the trap and keep the better game.

feedback.f3e5: 4.Nxe5 walks into 4...Qg5, which attacks the knight and g2 at once. Black comes out on top.

lessons.title: 3...f5 and 3...Be7
lessons.summary: Keep e4 covered against the gamble; hit the centre against the quiet move.

steps.text: 3...f5 is a gamble. It attacks e4 but opens Black's king.
Taking with 4.exf5 looks natural, but it gives up control of e4.
4...e4 attacks your knight on f3.
Back to 3...f5. Keep e4 covered with a pawn.
steps.ifWrong: 4.d3 keeps e4 covered. If Black takes with ...fxe4, a pawn takes back.
steps.ifRight: Black's king is now weak on the diagonal from c4 to g8.

feedback.e4f5: 4.exf5 lets ...e4 hit your knight. 4.d3 keeps e4 covered.

steps.text: Your bishop looks along the open diagonal from c4 to g8, where Black's king wants to castle.
3...Be7 is another quiet move. The bishop does not fight for the centre.
Strike in the centre.
steps.ifWrong: 4.d4: against a passive move, take the centre.
steps.ifRight: After ...exd4, take back and enjoy the better centre.

steps.text: Black takes with 4...exd4. You take back and keep the better centre.
Black gambles with 3...f5. Find the move that keeps your knight safe.
steps.ifWrong: 4.d3 keeps e4 covered. Taking on f5 would let ...e4 kick your knight.
steps.ifRight: e4 is covered, and Black's king is the weak one.

feedback.e4f5: 4.exf5 lets ...e4 hit your knight. 4.d3 keeps e4 covered.
